title: Mike Todd gets it right … on America’s true God
excerpt: Christian America (or Canada)? I don’t think so: http://miketodd.typepad.com/waving_or_drowning/2011/11/please-stand-well-back-of-the-false-god.html As someone said to me a while back, “We write ‘in God we trust’ on the God in whom we trust.”
body:
Christian America (or Canada)? I don’t think so:

 http://miketodd.typepad.com/waving_or_drowning/2011/11/please-stand-well-back-of-the-false-god.html

As someone said to me a while back, “We write ‘in God we trust’ on the God in whom we trust.”
